summary: Hub-only users and Event-Driven Ansible users are not moved to platform gateway in a 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade and must be recreated (with password reset); same-username accounts follow the controller account, and hub admins merged with controller users become normal users.
questions: Why was my automation hub user not migrated to platform gateway?
Are Event-Driven Ansible users migrated when upgrading to 2.6?
Do I need to recreate users after upgrading from 2.4 to 2.6?
What happens to automation hub admins after upgrade?

answer_card.title: Users not migrated in 2.4 → 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
Not moved to platform gateway (recreate manually, reset passwords):
- Users that exist **only in automation hub**
- **Event-Driven Ansible** users (EDA data is excluded)
- Duplicate usernames belonging to different people, or mismatched username/email between hub and controller

A user with the same username in controller and hub follows the controller account. Hub admins merged with controller users become normal users.
